turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Sure! While pineapple isn't a direct source of renewable energy like solar panels, we can draw an analogy. Both can be seen as part of sustainable practices. Pineapple leaves, for instance, can be repurposed as a natural pesticide or even turned into biofuel. Solar panels directly harness sunlight, a clean energy source, to generate electricity. Both contribute to reducing reliance on non-renewable resources and minimize environmental impact, fitting into broader green living initiatives.
